text:
Midweek, the lounge team read your email with care and we understand that you were upset by the way your companion animal's travel support was handled and by the feeling that your concerns were not taken seriously. We are sorry for that experience, and we appreciate you bringing it to our attention.

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk works with handlers who are trained to use calm, humane methods around animals, because we know that steadiness matters when a pet is already under strain. When a passenger raises a concern, our supervisors are expected to listen carefully, check the record, and make sure the response is respectful as well as practical. In your case, it appears that the service you received did not meet that standard, and that is not the experience we want to leave with anyone traveling with a companion animal.

We are reviewing what happened with the teams involved so that we can understand where the process fell short. If there was confusion during check-in, transfer, or animal handover, we will address it with the staff responsible and reinforce the correct handling approach. Our aim is to keep every animal safe, calm, and treated with patience, while also keeping the traveler informed in a clear and reassuring way.

We also want you to know that your concern has been noted as part of our routine service review, since these reports help us improve daily operations. If you choose to travel with us again, we would welcome the chance to provide a smoother experience and to give your companion animal the attentive care you expected from the start.

Thank you for taking the time to write to us. We are sorry again for the distress this caused, and we will continue working to do better.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
